description: This file contains functions and scripts for platform-specific operations related to system upgrades in OpenWrt, including root filesystem identification, disk detection, configuration copying, firmware flashing, and upgrade procedures for various hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_get_rootfs
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem device based on the kernel command line parameters.

methods.name: platform_get_n821_disk
methods.description: Finds the disk device associated with the N821 device for firmware update purposes.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_helper
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to a mounted device, depending on device path and filesystem type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Selects the appropriate device and calls the helper to copy configuration files based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_do_flash
methods.description: Performs flashing of kernel and root filesystem components from a tar file based on board type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade routine that identifies device and calls flashing functions.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the upgrade image for the board, checking the presence of kernel and root filesystem components.
